reason: The 'launch price for the first two clients' tells me nobody in Romania is using this yet, and the person building it does it on the side, 10-12 hours a week, next to a day job. I already lost money once to an agency that vanished; I am not paying 1,200 EUR up front to a one-man evening project with no portfolio.
objection: Who answers the phone in a year? If the day job gets busy or he gets bored, my site, my intake automation and my clients' document uploads sit on infrastructure nobody maintains. And I have 20-50 clients, I know most of them by name; AI pre-checking eligibility is solving a problem I don't really have.
would_change_my_mind: A named consulting firm in Bihor or Bucharest that has run this for at least six months, whose owner I can call myself, plus a written continuity plan (who takes over hosting and the automations if he stops).
